name: Jealousy Live Cartridge 1g
description:
1g pure Rest Liquid Live Resin (LLR) cartridge crafted from premium fresh frozen flower. Compatible with all 510 thread batteries.
Rest products are derived from indica strains, which are associated with calm and relaxation. Our Rest offerings pair well with quality time, evening wind-downs and restorative self-care.
Jealousy​ is an indica-leaning strain bred from crossing Sherbert Bx1 with Gelato 41. Top terpenes β-Caryophyllene, δ-Limonene, and β-Myrcene produce classic cannabis aromas defined by funky, earthy, and floral notes. Curl up and get comfy with a potentially sedative experience defined by physical lightness and the giggles.
